title: Group Projects
statementMd:
There are $*n*$ students in a class working on group projects. The students will divide into groups (some students may be in groups alone), work on their independent pieces, and then discuss the results together. It takes the $*i*$-th student $*a*_{*i*}$ minutes to finish his/her independent piece.

If students work at different paces, it can be frustrating for the faster students and stressful for the slower ones. In particular, the *imbalance* of a group is defined as the maximum $*a*_{*i*}$ in the group minus the minimum $*a*_{*i*}$ in the group. Note that a group containing a single student has an imbalance of $0$. How many ways are there for the students to divide into groups so that the total imbalance of all groups is at most $*k*$?

Two divisions are considered distinct if there exists a pair of students who work in the same group in one division but different groups in the other.

## Input

The first line contains two space-separated integers $*n*$ and $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 200$, $0 ≤ *k* ≤ 1000$) — the number of students and the maximum total imbalance allowed, respectively.

The second line contains $*n*$ space-separated integers $*a*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 500$) — the time it takes the $*i*$-th student to complete his/her independent piece of work.

## Output

Print a single integer, the number of ways the students can form groups. As the answer may be large, print its value modulo $10^{9} + 7$.

## Note

In the first sample, we have three options:

- The first and second students form a group, and the third student forms a group. Total imbalance is $2 + 0 = 2$.
- The first student forms a group, and the second and third students form a group. Total imbalance is $0 + 1 = 1$.
- All three students form their own groups. Total imbalance is $0$.

In the third sample, the total imbalance must be $0$, so each student must work individually.
statementZhMd:
班上有 $*n*$ 名学生正在进行小组项目。学生们将分成若干组（某些学生可能单独成组），分别完成自己的任务，然后一起讨论结果。第 $*i*$ 名学生需要 $*a*_{*i*}$ 分钟完成自己的任务。

如果学生们的完成速度不同，较快的学生可能会感到沮丧，而较慢的学生则会感到压力。具体来说，一个小组的*不平衡度*定义为该组中最大的 $*a*_{*i*}$ 减去最小的 $*a*_{*i*}$。注意，只包含一名学生的小组不平衡度为 $0$。求有多少种分组方式，使得所有小组的不平衡度之和不超过 $*k*$？

如果存在一对学生，使得他们在一种分组方式中属于同一组，而在另一种分组方式中属于不同的组，则认为这两种分组方式不同。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个用空格分隔的整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 200$，$0 ≤ *k* ≤ 1000$）——学生人数以及允许的最大总不平衡度。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个用空格分隔的整数 $*a*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 500$）——第 $*i*$ 名学生完成自己任务所需的时间。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，表示学生们分组的方案数。由于答案可能很大，请输出其对 $10^{9} + 7$ 取模后的结果。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，有三种方案：

- 第一名和第二名学生组成一组，第三名学生单独成组。总不平衡度为 $2 + 0 = 2$。
- 第一名学生单独成组，第二名和第三名学生组成一组。总不平衡度为 $0 + 1 = 1$。
- 三名学生各自单独成组。总不平衡度为 $0$。

在第三个样例中，总不平衡度必须为 $0$，因此每名学生都必须单独完成任务。
